moral: Wisdom grows with time and patience.

story: One day, Emperor Akbar asked Birbal, “Can you fill this pot with wisdom?” Birbal agreed and took the pot home. The next day, he returned with it covered. When Akbar opened it, he found a pumpkin inside. Birbal explained that the pumpkin grew slowly in the pot, just like wisdom grows with time and patience. Akbar understood and smiled.
